# NAGZ.SPACE

> Personal hub of Nagz a.k.a. Dávid Halmi: hobby music, music and audio commissions, mixed media art, Spotify playlists, career links and socials.

## Main links

- [Career](https://davidhalmi.com/): CV, career and LinkedIn links. Managing CRM, marketing, IT projects, building sites and other roles.
- [MusicOnPurpose](https://musiconpurpose.net/): Music and audio commissions, with a reference page.
- [Hobby music](https://music.nagz.space): Music released mainly as Nagz, member of Maniacs Of Noise since 2014.
- [OkayCoolWowEtc](https://okaycoolwowetc.com/): Mixed media art, mostly acrylic and fuse beads on canvas.
- [Playlists](https://playlists.nagz.space): Curated Spotify playlists.

## Optional

- [AFK is silent](https://linktr.ee/afk_is_silent): Short form geography, jingles and facts content.
